name: The Bioluminescent Caverns
layout: Limestone tunnel networks and huge cathedral caverns. Echoes amplify every sound, so stealth is vital. Tight squeezes need the Kite-Sub or swimming. Upper chambers hold air pockets with bat roosts. The Abandoned Underwater City lies here.
look: Pitch-black tunnels lit only by neon-blue, magenta and amber flora (about 1 to 200 lux) and pulsing creature organs; strobe flashes light the wet walls.
hazards: Extreme echo (amplifies Wake), cave-ins, blinding strobes from predators (up to about 50,000 lux), getting lost in narrow tunnels.
foodWeb: Chemosynthetic glowing fungi, lichens and bacterial mats feed plankton, blind crustaceans and grazers, while bat guano from the air pockets feeds beetles, prawns and molds. Glass-shrimp, cavefish and other grazers feed echolocating rays and gars, flash-hunters, and strobing cuttlefish and squid. Four apex giants, led by the Flash-Stalker Leviathan, hunt the mesopredators and follow strobe flashes and loud echoes.
source: The Deep Design Document.pdf, The ten ecosystems (3. The Bioluminescent Caverns, pages 34-46), Featured species, and The Abandoned Underwater City

flora.name: Lantern Vine
flora.description: Hangs from ceilings with neon-blue seed bulbs at 40 lux each

flora.name: Phosphor Mat
flora.description: Wall mat that pulses cyan and magenta every 3 s at 15 lux
flora.use: Flare chemicals, Phosphor Mat Battery Cells

flora.name: Lantern Shroom
flora.description: Squat amber caps on wet ledges, steady at 25 lux

flora.name: Acid Vine
flora.description: Pale green creeper that dissolves limestone and burns bare skin (8 lux)
flora.use: Etching acid for opening sealed rock and doors

flora.name: Neon Fungi
flora.description: Thin electric-blue shelves that stack up tunnel walls (20 lux)

flora.name: Pulse Lichen
flora.description: Crust on dripstone that throbs about 60 times a minute (6 lux)

flora.name: Crystal-Moss Mold
flora.description: Fuzzy mold that grows clear calcite needles (3 lux)

flora.name: Spore Tubule
flora.description: Clustered tubes that puff glowing spore clouds when touched (10 lux)

flora.name: Glow-Cap Spire
flora.description: 3 m spires rising from cavern floors, glowing at 120 lux

flora.name: Shroom Pouch
flora.description: Round pouch of glowing sap that sloshes and shines at 30 lux
flora.use: Raw sap for Echolocation Extract and sconces

flora.name: Lumen Filament
flora.description: Hair-thin strands that sway in currents like curtains (5 lux)

flora.name: Vivid Cluster
flora.description: Grape-like magenta nodules tucked into crevices (20 lux)

flora.name: Strobe Shroom
flora.description: Fires an 8,000 lux burst when disturbed, then dims for a minute

flora.name: Beacon Fungi
flora.description: Steady amber columns at 200 lux; predators patrol nearby

flora.name: Radiant Lichen
flora.description: Warm orange crust near mineral seeps that gives off heat (12 lux)

flora.name: Flicker Mold
flora.description: Mold on guano piles that flickers erratically (8 lux)

flora.name: Glimmer Tubule
flora.description: Pipe-organ tubes that hum Mid-band tones in currents (15 lux)

flora.name: Vapour Pouch
flora.description: Translucent bladder of buoyant gas, faint blue at 4 lux

flora.name: Spark Filament
flora.description: Crackling violet strands that shock on contact (35 lux)

flora.name: Ember Cluster
flora.description: Amber nodules around warm seeps, glowing at 50 lux

fauna.name: Glowmote Copepod
fauna.description: Neon-blue copepod drifting in clouds that lights the water when disturbed.
fauna.tactics: Drifts in clouds; flares to 0.5 lux when disturbed, lighting up whatever moves through it.
fauna.behavior: Neon-blue specks drifting in clouds; light the water when disturbed (0.5 lux)

fauna.name: Lumen Rotifer
fauna.description: Microscopic rotifer that spins in dense swarms around spore plumes.
fauna.tactics: Gathers in dense spinning swarms; no defence beyond numbers.
fauna.behavior: Gathers in dense spinning swarms around spore plumes

fauna.name: Spore-Drift Larva
fauna.description: Amber larva riding the slow currents between chambers.
fauna.tactics: Passive drift on slow cave currents between chambers.
fauna.behavior: Amber larvae ride slow cave currents between chambers

fauna.name: Sparkdrift Dinoflagellate
fauna.description: Dinoflagellate bloom that sparkles magenta along anything moving through it.
fauna.tactics: Sparkles magenta in a moving diver's wake, giving the diver away.
fauna.behavior: Sparkles magenta along wakes; reveals moving divers

fauna.name: Neon Krill-Mite
fauna.description: Ticking krill-mite that swarms on filament curtains.
fauna.tactics: Ticking swarms cling to filament curtains and scatter when brushed.
fauna.behavior: Ticking swarms that cling to filament curtains

fauna.name: Blind Lamp-Isopod
fauna.description: Blind isopod that files along walls scraping glowing mats clean.
fauna.tactics: Crawls walls in single-file lines; curls up when touched.
fauna.behavior: Crawls walls in lines and scrapes glowing trails clean

fauna.name: Mat-Scraper Amphipod
fauna.description: Jittery amphipod hopping across phosphor mats.
fauna.tactics: Hops across mats in jittery bursts that are hard to follow.
fauna.behavior: Hops across mats in jittery bursts

fauna.name: Lichen-Lick Snail
fauna.description: Small snail leaving dark tracks through glowing lichen.
fauna.tactics: Slow grazer; relies on its shell; its dark tracks lead to it.
fauna.behavior: Leaves dark tracks through glowing lichen

fauna.name: Glowcap Nibbler
fauna.description: Schooling fish that crops mushroom caps and scatters from lights.
fauna.tactics: Schools crop shroom caps and scatter at dive lights.
fauna.behavior: Schooling fish that crops shroom caps and scatters at lights

fauna.name: Ghostfin Cavefish
fauna.description: Blind, translucent cavefish that feels pressure waves.
fauna.tactics: Blind; feels pressure waves and darts away from anything that displaces water.
fauna.behavior: Blind and translucent; senses pressure waves

fauna.name: Fungus-Rasper Chiton
fauna.description: Chiton rasping neon fungi off the walls.
fauna.tactics: Clamps tight to rock when touched; its rasping is audible.
fauna.behavior: Clamps tight to rock when touched; its rasping is audible

fauna.name: Lantern Slug
fauna.description: Sea slug that takes in the glow of what it eats and pulses blue.
fauna.tactics: Slow; its blue pulse marks it to predators.
fauna.behavior: Takes in the glow of what it eats and pulses blue

fauna.name: Glowfruit Bat
fauna.description: Fruit bat roosting in air pockets and feeding on glowing fruit and vines.
fauna.tactics: Roosts in colonies in air pockets; drops guano that feeds the chamber below.
fauna.behavior: Roosts in air pockets and drops guano into the water

fauna.name: Stalactite Urchin
fauna.description: Urchin that hangs upside down from ceilings and grinds spire bases.
fauna.tactics: Hangs upside down from ceilings; spines deter predators.
fauna.behavior: Hangs upside down from ceilings and grinds spire bases

fauna.name: Pale Mat-Crayfish
fauna.description: Blind crayfish that guards its feeding patch with snapping displays.
fauna.tactics: Blind; guards feeding patches with snapping displays.
fauna.behavior: Blind; guards feeding patches with snapping displays

fauna.name: Mineral-Tongue Limpet
fauna.description: Acid-resistant limpet etching grooves into limestone.
fauna.tactics: Clamps flat to limestone; resists acid and shocks.
fauna.behavior: Resists acid; etches grooves into limestone

fauna.name: Ember Sea-Hare
fauna.description: Sea hare that squirts glowing amber ink when attacked.
fauna.tactics: Squirts a cloud of glowing amber ink when attacked.
fauna.behavior: Squirts glowing amber ink when attacked

fauna.name: Cave Glow-Midge
fauna.description: Midge whose larvae glow underwater and whose adults swarm in air pockets.
fauna.tactics: Adults swarm in air pockets; glowing larvae drift just under the surface.
fauna.behavior: Larvae glow underwater; adults swarm in air pockets

fauna.name: Moss-Bear Tardigrade
fauna.description: Slow giant tardigrade that survives cave collapses.
fauna.tactics: Slow; survives cave-ins by curling into a dry husk.
fauna.behavior: Slow giant tardigrade that survives cave collapses

fauna.name: Lumen Sea-Cucumber
fauna.description: Sea cucumber vacuuming cavern floors and leaving glowing casts.
fauna.tactics: Slow; its glowing casts mark where it has fed.
fauna.behavior: Slowly vacuums cavern floors and leaves glowing casts

fauna.name: Glass-Cave Shrimp
fauna.description: Blind glassy shrimp that flashes when startled by dive lights; featured as the caverns' blind filter feeder.
fauna.tactics: Completely blind; senses pressure with long antennae. Startled by dive lights, it flashes, sending the whole swarm into crevices and alerting the area's predators.
fauna.behavior: Blind; flashes when startled by dive lights, alerting predators

fauna.name: Chandelier Sponge
fauna.description: Sponge hanging from cavern domes like a glowing chandelier (10 lux).
fauna.tactics: Sessile; hangs from domes and lights the chamber at 10 lux.
fauna.behavior: Hangs from domes like a glowing chandelier (10 lux)

fauna.name: Drip Tubeworm
fauna.description: Tubeworm growing in clusters under drip points.
fauna.tactics: Sessile; plumes retract at any vibration.
fauna.behavior: Grows in clusters under drip points; plumes retract at vibration

fauna.name: Grotto Feather-Duster
fauna.description: Fan worm whose magenta crowns sweep the currents.
fauna.tactics: Magenta crown snaps shut into its tube at passing shadows.
fauna.behavior: Magenta crowns sweep currents and snap shut at shadows

fauna.name: Lantern Barnacle
fauna.description: Barnacle crusting tunnel mouths; its glowing cirri mark the passages.
fauna.tactics: Sessile; crusts tunnel mouths, its glowing cirri marking the way through.
fauna.behavior: Crusts tunnel mouths; its glowing cirri mark the passages

fauna.name: Cavern Echo-Clam
fauna.description: Clam whose shell claps echo loudly through the chambers.
fauna.tactics: Sessile; its shell claps carry through the chambers and draw hunters.
fauna.behavior: Shell claps echo loudly through chambers

fauna.name: Halo Comb-Jelly
fauna.description: Comb jelly with rippling rainbow cilia drifting through cathedral chambers.
fauna.tactics: Drifts passively; its rippling cilia shimmer in the dark.
fauna.behavior: Rainbow cilia ripple; drifts through cathedral chambers

fauna.name: Siphon Glow-Mussel
fauna.description: Mussel in dense beds that glow when divers swim over them.
fauna.tactics: Sessile beds light up under a passing diver, giving them away.
fauna.behavior: Dense beds glow when divers swim over them

fauna.name: Echo-Ray
fauna.description: Blind ray mapping the tunnels with continuous 45 kHz clicks; featured as the caverns' echolocating hunter.
fauna.tactics: Hunts in total darkness; narrow tunnels extend its detection range, so crews must use Silent Running or Dead in the Water. Guards its egg clusters.
fauna.behavior: Continuous 45 kHz clicks map tunnels; hunts in total darkness; guards egg clusters
fauna.yields: Echo-Ray Vocal Cord; Echo-Ray Brain Tissue; Echo-Ray Egg (from egg clusters)

fauna.name: Flash-Hunter Darter
fauna.description: Darting fish that fires a 500 lux eye-flash to freeze prey.
fauna.tactics: Fires a 500 lux eye-flash to freeze prey, then lunges.
fauna.behavior: Fires a 500 lux eye-flash to freeze prey, then lunges

fauna.name: Strobe-Squid
fauna.description: Pack-hunting squid whose 3,000 lux strobes blind its prey.
fauna.tactics: Hunts in packs; 3,000 lux strobes blind its prey, and divers caught in the volley.
fauna.behavior: Hunts in packs; 3,000 lux strobes blind its prey

fauna.name: Grotto Lamprey
fauna.description: Lamprey that latches onto prey and drains it.
fauna.tactics: Latches onto prey and drains it; follows blood trails.
fauna.behavior: Latches onto prey, drains it, and is drawn to blood

fauna.name: Ghost-Olm
fauna.description: Pale, eyeless giant olm that waits motionless for days.
fauna.tactics: Waits motionless for days, then snaps up anything that brushes it.
fauna.behavior: Pale and eyeless; waits motionless for days

fauna.name: Lure-Lantern Angler
fauna.description: Angler dangling a 60 lux lure that mimics Lantern Vine seeds.
fauna.tactics: Dangles a 60 lux lure that mimics Lantern Vine seeds; ambushes careless collectors.
fauna.behavior: Dangles a 60 lux lure that mimics Lantern Vine seeds

fauna.name: Strobe Mantis Shrimp
fauna.description: Mantis shrimp whose club strike cracks viewports; it flashes before it snaps.
fauna.tactics: Flashes a warning, then strikes with a club that cracks viewports.
fauna.behavior: Club strike cracks viewports; flashes before it snaps

fauna.name: Skimmer Bat
fauna.description: Echolocating bat snatching prey from air-pocket surfaces.
fauna.tactics: Echolocates over air-pocket pools and snatches prey from the surface.
fauna.behavior: Echolocates and snatches prey from air-pocket surfaces

fauna.name: Lumen Tunnel-Eel
fauna.description: Ambush eel in tight squeezes; its blue lateral line glows at 5 lux.
fauna.tactics: Ambushes from squeezes; its faint blue lateral line is the only warning.
fauna.behavior: Ambushes from squeezes; its blue lateral line glows at 5 lux

fauna.name: Grotto Mimic Octopus
fauna.description: Octopus that copies the glow patterns of nearby flora to hide.
fauna.tactics: Copies the glow patterns of nearby flora to hide; squirts ink when found.
fauna.behavior: Copies the glow patterns of nearby flora to hide

fauna.name: Arc-Jaw Cavefish
fauna.description: Cavefish with a hinged jaw that bites prey out of crevices.
fauna.tactics: Hinged jaw shoots out to pluck prey from crevices.
fauna.behavior: Hinged jaw bites prey out of crevices

fauna.name: Bat-Fin Echo-Gar
fauna.description: Echolocating gar that patrols the main tunnels.
fauna.tactics: Patrols the main tunnels on 30 kHz clicks; an active sonar ping draws it.
fauna.behavior: Echolocating gar that patrols the main tunnels

fauna.name: Strobe Box-Jelly

fauna.tactics: Drifts with strobing tentacles; the venom of a full sting can kill an unsuited diver.
fauna.behavior: Stinging tentacles strobe 1,000 lux in sequence

fauna.name: Grotto Pincer-Lobster
fauna.description: Territorial lobster whose clacking claws echo through the tunnels.
fauna.tactics: Territorial; claws clack loudly as a warning, then pinch.
fauna.behavior: Territorial; claws clack loudly through the echoes

fauna.name: Magenta Lamp-Leech
fauna.description: Leech that follows blood trails and swells magenta when fed.
fauna.tactics: Follows blood trails; swells and glows magenta when fed.
fauna.behavior: Follows blood trails; swells magenta when fed

fauna.name: Lumen Barracuda
fauna.description: Fast barracuda striking at the outline of glowing prey.
fauna.tactics: Fast strikes at the outline of anything glowing, dive lamps included.
fauna.behavior: Fast strikes at the outline of glowing prey

fauna.name: Hollow-Cave Seal
fauna.description: Cave seal that hauls out in air pockets; its barks echo for kilometres.
fauna.tactics: Hauls out in air pockets; hunts bats at the surface; its barks echo for kilometres.
fauna.behavior: Hauls out in air pockets; its barks echo for kilometers

fauna.name: Strobe Cuttlefish
fauna.description: Cuttlefish whose hypnotic 5,000 lux skin strobes stun its prey.
fauna.tactics: Hypnotic 5,000 lux skin strobes stun prey, and dazzle divers who look.
fauna.behavior: Hypnotic 5,000 lux skin strobes stun its prey

fauna.name: Glimmer Stargazer
fauna.description: Stargazer buried in the floor with only its glowing eyes showing.

fauna.behavior: Buries itself with only its glowing eyes showing

fauna.name: Calcite Spearworm
fauna.description: Bobbit-like worm bursting from limestone burrows to drag prey under.
fauna.tactics: Bursts from limestone burrows and drags prey under.
fauna.behavior: Bursts from limestone burrows and drags prey under

fauna.name: Cave Cleaner Beetle
fauna.description: Beetle swarming guano heaps in partly flooded upper chambers; featured as the caverns' scavenger.
fauna.tactics: Swarms guano heaps on air-pocket ledges; its 15 dB scuttle on wet limestone carries far, and the Abandoned City magnifies it.
fauna.behavior: Swarms guano heaps on air-pocket ledges; cleans up detritus

fauna.description: Hagfish that reaches a carcass within minutes and floods it with glowing slime.

fauna.behavior: Reaches a carcass within minutes and floods it with glowing slime

fauna.name: Limestone Giant Isopod
fauna.description: Giant isopod that rolls into an armoured ball when threatened.
fauna.tactics: Rolls into an armoured ball when threatened.
fauna.behavior: Rolls into an armored ball when threatened

fauna.name: Carrion Lamp-Amphipod
fauna.description: Amphipod whose glowing swarms strip carcasses to the bone overnight.
fauna.tactics: Glowing swarms strip carcasses to bone overnight.
fauna.behavior: Glowing swarms strip carcasses to bone overnight

fauna.name: Lantern Brittlestar
fauna.description: Brittle star whose arms glow in a chain when disturbed.
fauna.tactics: Its arms light up in a running chain when disturbed, then it flees.
fauna.behavior: Its arms glow in a chain when disturbed

fauna.name: Guano-Sift Prawn
fauna.description: Prawn gathering under bat roosts to sift the falling guano.
fauna.tactics: Gathers in crowds under bat roosts and sifts the falling guano.
fauna.behavior: Gathers under bat roosts and sifts the falling guano

fauna.name: Calcite Decorator Crab
fauna.description: Crab that hides under glowing fungi and calcite chips.
fauna.tactics: Camouflages itself under glowing fungi and calcite chips.
fauna.behavior: Hides under glowing fungi and calcite chips

fauna.name: Shroud Carrion-Eel
fauna.description: Eel that trails behind leviathans to take their leftovers.
fauna.tactics: Trails behind leviathans to take their leftovers; its presence warns of one nearby.
fauna.behavior: Trails behind leviathans to take their leftovers

fauna.name: Flash-Stalker Leviathan
fauna.description: The caverns' resident leviathan: a 30 m cave predator with a ring of strobe organs around its jaw.
fauna.tactics: Clicks low and blinds viewports and HUD screens with 50,000 lux jaw strobes before striking; in the Abandoned City it corners prey in the alleys and bounces its strobes off the polished walls. Flashbang flares overload its eyes and force it to retreat.
fauna.behavior: Jaw strobes fire about 50,000 lux, blinding viewports and HUDs; flashbang flares overload its eyes and force retreat

fauna.name: Choir Leviathan
fauna.description: 22 m leviathan whose echoing calls stun schools in the cathedral caverns.
fauna.tactics: Sings stunning calls that echo through cathedral caverns, then feeds on the stunned.
fauna.behavior: Its echoing calls stun schools in cathedral caverns

fauna.name: Lumen-Veil Kraken
fauna.description: 15 m kraken that spreads a glowing veil across tunnel mouths and waits.
fauna.tactics: Spreads a glowing veil of webbed arms across a tunnel mouth and waits for prey to swim into it.
fauna.behavior: Spreads a glowing veil across tunnel mouths and waits

fauna.name: Cathedral Gulper
fauna.description: 18 m gulper whose huge mouth swallows whole sections of the chamber floor.
fauna.tactics: Swallows whole sections of the chamber floor, and anything on it.
fauna.behavior: Huge mouth swallows whole sections of the chamber floor

interactions: Echoes amplify every sound in the caverns, so stealth is vital; the Abandoned City's stonework magnifies even a Cave Cleaner Beetle's 15 dB scuttle, and crews must stay Dead in the Water crossing its grand plazas.

Echo-Rays map the tunnels with continuous 45 kHz clicks and hunt in total darkness; narrow tunnels extend their detection range, so crews use Silent Running or Dead in the Water. They guard their egg clusters.
An active sonar ping alerts every echolocator in range: Echo-Rays, Skimmer Bats and Bat-Fin Echo-Gars.
The four apex giants, led by the Flash-Stalker Leviathan, hunt the mesopredators and follow strobe flashes and loud echoes.

The Flash-Stalker Leviathan blinds viewports and HUD screens with 50,000 lux jaw strobes before striking; flashbang flares overload its eyes and force it to retreat. In the Abandoned City it corners prey in the alleys, bouncing its strobes off the polished walls to blind divers from several angles at once.
Glass-Cave Shrimp startled by dive lights flash, sending the whole swarm into crevices and alerting the area's predators.
Sparkdrift Dinoflagellates sparkle magenta along a moving diver's wake, and Siphon Glow-Mussel beds light up when divers swim over them, giving the crew away.

Glowfruit Bats roost in the air pockets of the upper chambers and drop guano into the water, feeding Cave Cleaner Beetles, Guano-Sift Prawns, Lantern Brittlestars and Flicker Mold; Skimmer Bats and Hollow-Cave Seals hunt them there.
Lure-Lantern Anglers dangle a 60 lux lure that mimics Lantern Vine seeds; Grotto Mimic Octopuses copy the glow patterns of nearby flora to hide.

Strobe-Squid packs (3,000 lux), Strobe Cuttlefish (5,000 lux), Flash-Hunter Darters (500 lux) and Strobe Box-Jellies (1,000 lux) stun or freeze prey with light; Lumen Barracuda strike at the outline of anything glowing.
Grotto Lampreys and Magenta Lamp-Leeches follow blood trails; Glowslime Hagfish reach a carcass within minutes and Carrion Lamp-Amphipod swarms strip it to bone overnight.
Shroud Carrion-Eels trail behind the leviathans to take their leftovers.

The Choir Leviathan's echoing calls stun schools in the cathedral caverns; the Lumen-Veil Kraken spreads a glowing veil across tunnel mouths and waits; the Cathedral Gulper swallows whole sections of the chamber floor.
Cavern Echo-Clam shell claps, Grotto Pincer-Lobster claw clacks and Hollow-Cave Seal barks echo for kilometres through the chambers.
Beacon Fungi's steady 200 lux columns draw patrolling predators; Strobe Shrooms fire an 8,000 lux burst when disturbed, then dim for a minute.
Glimmer Tubules hum Mid-band tones in the currents, and their resonators make sound decoys that lure predators; Spore Tubules puff glowing spore clouds when touched.
Acid Vine burns bare skin and Spark Filament shocks on contact; Mineral-Tongue Limpets graze both.
Lantern Vines and Phosphor Mats overgrow the Abandoned City's statues, making blindingly bright main streets and pitch-black alleys.
Moss-Bear Tardigrades survive cave-ins that bury everything else.
